tldr: DeepSeek open-sourced Harness in mid-August as an MIT-licensed agent framework where models, tools, and skills are all plugins, drawing immediate comparisons to Claude Cowork. A fast release cadence followed — a v0.1 preview, then a 14-change post-beta update adding multimodal and subagent support — before Harness began orchestrating rival coding agents instead of just running its own.
whats_new: QiAnXin disclosed a critical remote-code-execution flaw in Harness on Aug 25 — the first reported security vulnerability in the two-week-old framework.
why_it_matters: A critical RCE in an MIT-licensed runtime that can already host Claude Code and Codex as sub-agents is a directly exploitable risk for anyone who prototyped against it — this changes evaluation from a capability bake-off into a patch-and-verify check first.

status.state: Active iteration · critical RCE disclosed Aug 25
status.detail: Harness moved from open-source launch to orchestrating rival coding agents as sub-agents within eight days, then had a critical remote-code-execution flaw disclosed by QiAnXin two weeks after launch — no DeepSeek patch confirmed yet.

beats.summary: The first reported security vulnerability in the two-week-old framework, disclosed the day after the plugin-architecture deep dive. No DeepSeek patch or fix timeline confirmed yet.

open_questions: Has DeepSeek shipped a patch for the QiAnXin-reported RCE, and is it exploitable in a default Harness install or only under specific plugin configurations?
Does DeepSeek publish independent benchmarks for Harness's sub-agent orchestration, or only vendor/Chinese-press claims?
How stable is the plugin API across the rapid v0.1 → post-beta → weekly-update cadence — will early plugins break?
Does hosting Claude Code and Codex as sub-agents require API keys or licensing terms from Anthropic and OpenAI, or is it a wrapper around local CLIs?
Will English-language technical documentation and independent community adoption follow the current, largely Chinese-press coverage?
take_for_builders: Before evaluating Harness further, confirm whether the QiAnXin-reported RCE is patched, and avoid pointing it at untrusted plugins or tools until it is — then prototype against its plugin/subagent interface as a Claude Code/Codex orchestration-layer alternative.
